transcript: That day, a special exhibition was being held at the museum Valuable paintings brought from Europe were being exhibited in Japan For the first time, at the entrance, I bought a ticket and walked along the route In the first room, portraits from the 15th century were on display The faces of kings and nobles, painted with a primitive yet powerful brushstroke The next room held Impressionist paintings Monet, Renoir, Degas Attempts to capture the light appeared each with the personality of its artist I stopped before one painting and gazed at it for a long time Other visitors passed by whispering A female guide was explaining the historical background of the paintings to newly arrived students. They were eagerly taking notes. When I left the museum, I carried a profound satisfaction. In my heart, art, across time and place, quietly brings relief to the heart of the viewer It is not a luxury, but one of the forms of nourishment that human beings need You
